67.name: 67 (6 7, six seven)
67.blurb: A shouted "six seven" meme from a 2025 rap song; it has no fixed meaning

520.blurb: Chinese number code for "I love you"; May 20 is an online Valentine's Day

666.blurb: Chinese internet praise meaning "awesome, so skilled"; 6 sounds like 溜 (smooth)

334424044.blurb: The string of numbers sung over and over in the Cantonese song Red Pen

yyds.name: yyds
yyds.blurb: Chinese abbreviation of 永远的神, "eternal god": the GOAT, the best ever

xswl.name: xswl
xswl.blurb: Chinese abbreviation of 笑死我了, "I'm dying of laughter", like LMAO

awsl.name: awsl
awsl.blurb: Chinese abbreviation of 啊我死了, "ah, I'm dead", said about something unbearably cute

dbq.name: dbq
dbq.blurb: Chinese abbreviation of 对不起 (duì bu qǐ), "sorry", used in casual chat

cpdd.name: cpdd
cpdd.blurb: Chinese gaming slang: "looking for a CP (partner), hit me up"

neijuan.name: Neijuan (内卷)
neijuan.blurb: Chinese slang for "involution": ever harder competition that leaves everyone worse off

tangping.name: Tang ping (躺平)
tangping.blurb: Chinese slang for "lying flat": opting out of the rat race and living with low desires

bailan.name: Bai lan (摆烂)
bailan.blurb: Chinese slang for "letting it rot": giving up on something that won't get better

niuma.name: Niuma (牛马)
niuma.blurb: Chinese office slang: "oxen and horses", workers worked like beasts of burden

caotai-banzi.name: Caotai banzi (草台班子)
caotai-banzi.blurb: Chinese slang for a slapdash outfit that only looks professional

fanersai.name: Fanersai (凡尔赛)
fanersai.blurb: Chinese slang for "Versailles": a humblebrag dressed up as a complaint

chigua.name: Chigua (吃瓜)
chigua.blurb: Chinese slang for "eating melon": watching gossip and drama from the sidelines

emo.name: Emo (Chinese slang)
emo.blurb: Chinese internet slang for feeling down or blue, as in 我emo了 ("I'm feeling emo")

pofang.name: Pofang (破防)
pofang.blurb: Chinese slang for having your emotional defenses broken: deeply moved, hurt or provoked

qingxu-jiazhi.name: Qingxu jiazhi (情绪价值)
qingxu-jiazhi.blurb: Chinese buzzword for "emotional value": how good someone makes others feel

i-ren-e-ren.name: i ren / e ren (i人 / e人)
i-ren-e-ren.blurb: Chinese MBTI slang: i人 is an introvert, e人 an extrovert

sheniu.name: Sheniu (社牛)
sheniu.blurb: Chinese slang for a fearless socializer who is never embarrassed in public

hajimi.name: Hajimi (哈基米)
hajimi.blurb: Chinese slang for a cat, from a misheard Japanese word for honey in Uma Musume

baiyueguang.name: Baiyueguang (白月光)
baiyueguang.blurb: Chinese slang for the one you never got and never forgot, often a first love

haiwang.name: Haiwang (海王)
haiwang.blurb: Chinese slang for a player who keeps many romantic interests on the hook

zhanan.name: Zhanan (渣男)
zhanan.blurb: Chinese slang insult for a man who cheats, lies or treats partners badly

puxinnan.name: Puxinnan (普信男)
puxinnan.blurb: Chinese slang for an ordinary man with unearned confidence

lianainao.name: Lianainao (恋爱脑)
lianainao.blurb: Chinese slang for a "love brain": someone who loses all judgment when in love

tiangou.name: Tiangou (舔狗)
tiangou.blurb: Chinese slang for a simp: someone who keeps fawning over a person who isn't interested

pua.name: PUA (Chinese slang)
pua.blurb: From "pickup artist"; in Chinese, manipulating someone with put-downs, at work or in love

rizz.name: rizz
rizz.blurb: Charm or skill at flirting; to "rizz someone up" is to win them over

fomo.name: FOMO
fomo.blurb: Fear of missing out: worry that others are having fun or gains without you

crush.name: crush
crush.blurb: A strong, often secret, romantic liking for someone, or the person you like

ootd.name: OOTD
ootd.blurb: Outfit of the day: a post showing what you are wearing today

situationship.name: situationship
situationship.blurb: A romantic or physical relationship that has never been defined or labelled

npc.name: NPC
npc.blurb: A game's non-player character; as slang, someone who seems to act on autopilot

delulu.name: delulu
delulu.blurb: Short for delusional; believing something unrealistic, often on purpose

iykyk.name: IYKYK
iykyk.blurb: If you know, you know: marks an inside joke only some people will get

smh.name: SMH
smh.blurb: Shaking my head: shows disappointment, disbelief or disapproval in a text

simp.name: simp
simp.blurb: Mocking slang for someone who tries too hard to please a person they like

no-cap.name: no cap
no-cap.blurb: "No lie" or "for real": stresses that you are not exaggerating
